compatibility.notes: No project-format or settings migration is introduced by this release. The persisted project schema is unchanged, and the Story Tags redesign reconciles existing tag-color and filter preferences without adding a settings migration. Passage rename, story-wide replacement, and deterministic diagnostic fixes change project data only after explicit review and confirmation, and each confirmed operation is one atomic Undo/Redo transaction. The immutable beta.5 CLI reopened a beta.6-created project and its restored backup with matching story identity, format, passage, and link summaries. A separate project-folder backup remains recommended before prerelease use.

rollback.application: Uninstall or discontinue using beta.6 and reinstall the previous known-good beta.5 release. Automatic downgrade is unavailable.
rollback.projectData: Beta.5 can reopen the unchanged beta.6 project format. If project-data recovery is required, stop editing, restore the separate pre-beta.6 project-folder backup, and reopen that restored project with beta.5.

knownIssues: In the current benchmark suite, some latency and memory results at the largest tested project sizes exceed the project's initial performance targets.
Advanced Harlowe syntax editing and Harlowe-specific semantic navigation are specific to the bundled Harlowe 3.3.9 format; other Harlowe versions use the generic editor and standard-link navigation.
Asset-complete Package export is limited to file-backed desktop projects. Static runtime dependencies are assessed, while dynamic JavaScript dependency discovery is explicitly not evaluated.

Runtime Debugger inspection remains exact-version and read-only. Runtime Controls are limited to Restart and Clear State; adapter support varies, and Chapbook plus generic adapters expose current-passage state only.
Some inherited editing, troubleshooting, installation, and compatibility documentation still requires a final Twine RS-specific audit.
Cross-platform packaged-app and hosted-CI performance coverage remains incomplete.
